description: A sample player one module wide. It plays a selection out of the loaded sample, once or in a loop, and every audio file in the same directory as that one is listed so any of them can be picked

params.text: Sets the playback speed, -2x to +2x, default 1x; a negative speed plays the selection backwards
Attenuates the voltage arriving at the FM input
Switched on, the selection repeats; switched off, playback ends at the end of the selection
A tap starts playback from the beginning of the selection
A tap stops playback, and the next one carries on from where it stopped
Switched on, the sample plays only while the start gate is high and stops when it drops
Sets where in the sample playback starts, and set below zero moves the end point instead

inputs.text: A voltage added to the playback speed; at audio rate it becomes frequency modulation of the sample
A pulse starts playback from the beginning of the selection, and with GATED switched on a gate holds it
A pulse stops playback, and the next one carries on from where it stopped
A voltage moving the start point in the sample

outputs.text: One side of the stereo output
A pulse each time playback reaches the end of the selection

notes: the Simpler File Control expander steps through the list of audio files in the sample's directory, by pulse or by voltage
nothing plays until a sample is loaded, which is done from the menu
menu: MAX IMPORTABLE FILE SIZE — caps what can be loaded: Any file size, or Max 50, 20, 10, 5, 2 or 1 Mbytes
Speed CV input reducer — divides the voltage at the speed input before it is used: No reduction, Divide by 2, Divide by 5 or Divide by 10
Reset Playhead When Changing Sample — puts playback back to the start whenever a different file is picked
Open WAV or AIFF File... — loads a wav or aiff file as the sample
